password_resets_user_matches_kind.name: password_resets_user_matches_kind
password_resets_user_matches_kind.value: ("password_resets"."user_kind" = 'dealer' AND "password_resets"."dealer_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "password_resets"."backoffice_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("password_resets"."user_kind" = 'backoffice' AND "password_resets"."backoffice_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "password_resets"."dealer_user_id" IS NULL)

sessions_user_matches_kind.name: sessions_user_matches_kind
sessions_user_matches_kind.value: ("sessions"."user_kind" = 'dealer' AND "sessions"."dealer_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."backoffice_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("sessions"."user_kind" = 'backoffice' AND "sessions"."backoffice_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."dealer_user_id" IS NULL)

holiday_overrides_open_hours.name: holiday_overrides_open_hours
holiday_overrides_open_hours.value: NOT "holiday_overrides"."is_open" OR ("holiday_overrides"."opens_at" IS NOT NULL AND "holiday_overrides"."closes_at" IS NOT NULL AND "holiday_overrides"."opens_at" < "holiday_overrides"."closes_at")
